scope: Selected complete typed sample sequences from read-only native observations driven with virtual-pad input. The reports used revision 19 plus local observation counters; the released final input helper was additionally verified by the native-dispatcher CPU fixtures and public startup readback. These are scoped observations, not an exhaustive game playthrough.
export_policy: Account-free typed fields only. No process dump, original executable bytes, profiles, screenshots, host paths, arbitrary memory buffers or unverified guard-condition/outcome interpretations. Original report SHA-256 values identify the retained private source reports.
